# Expanding review intervals

Repeated retrieval should be separated in time. After an unaided correct response, lengthen the next interval; after an error, bring the item back sooner and inspect the prompt. Schedule by observed recall rather than the date on which a card was created.

One fixed calendar for every word ignores differences in difficulty. A missed review is not a reason to restart the entire deck. Limit the daily workload and suspend ambiguous cards until they are rewritten. The scheduler determines when practice occurs; it cannot turn a recognition-only exercise into productive recall.
